earnings.title: MIAMI — (BUSINESS WIRE) — Palantir Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ:PLTR) today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
highlights: “Witness our third quarter results: overall revenue soared 96% year-over-year, U.S. commercial revenue grew 148% year-over-year and 29% sequentially, and aggregate U.S. revenue grew 119% year-over-year.
U.S. revenue grew 119% year-over-year and 23% quarter-over-quarter to $1.937 billion
U.S. commercial revenue grew 148% year-over-year and 29% quarter-over-quarter to $984 million
U.S. government revenue grew 96% year-over-year and 18% quarter-over-quarter to $953 million
Revenue grew 96% year-over-year and 20% quarter-over-quarter to $2.313 billion

quotes.text: The Sovereign AI movement is imposing the most dramatic dichotomy between haves and have nots that I have witnessed in 30 years of business. Every institution—government and commercial—is rapidly being forced, voluntarily or not, into one of these two categories.
quotes.by: Alex Karp, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Palantir Technologies

outlook: Comm Revenue Growth of 148% Y/Y and Revenue Growth of 96% Y/Y; Raises FY 2026 Revenue Guidance to 91% Y/Y Growth and U.S.
Comm Revenue Guidance to 143% Y/Y, Crushing Consensus Expectations
Adjusted income from operations of between $1.640 - $1.644 billion.

items.heading: We may not be able to sustain our revenue growth in the future.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: We may not realize the full deal value of our customer contracts, which may result in lower than expected revenue.
If we fail to manage future growth effectively, our business could be harmed.
We anticipate our operating expenses will continue to increase and we may not be able to maintain profitability in the future.

Our results of operations and our key business measures are likely to fluctuate significantly on a quarterly basis in future periods and may not fully reflect the underlying performance of our business, which makes our future results difficult to predict and could cause our results of operations to fall below expectations.
Seasonality may cause fluctuations in our results of operations and financial position.
